rules.prepare:
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR"
PF="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" sed -i "s@/lib:/usr/local/lib:/usr/lib@$PF/lib:$PF/local/lib@g" ldso/dynlink.c
if [ "$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" = "/tools" ]; then
# to avoid collision with the target musl linker config sed -i 's@/etc/ld-musl-@/etc/ld-musl-tools-@g' ldso/dynlink.c
# this is the magic redirection patch patch -p1 < "$AELTRA_WORK_DIR/patches/bbox-redirect-bin-sh.patch"
fi
./configure \ --prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --syslibdir="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/lib" \ --target="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE"
rules.install:
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" make DESTDIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR" install
install -d -m 0755 "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/share" install -d -m 0755 "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/share/misc"
echo "musl" > "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/share/misc/libc.name"
